newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tchibo corrects earlier market share details.
newsitem.headline: Tchibo corrects earlier market share details.

text.p: Germany's Tchibo Holding AG, which plans to buy competitor Eduscho GmbH & Co, wished to correct market share indications it had offered earlier today for the two companies, spokeswoman Birgit Klesper said.
She said Tchibo's volume share in the roasted coffee market was always fluctuating and was pointing downwards at the moment.
The company is the second largest German coffee roaster.

Tchibo could not comment on Eduscho numbers and wished to stress the market shares should not be added up because it was planned to continue to operate the two firms independently, should the sale be given approval by monopoly authorities, Klesper said.
Earlier today, a Tchibo spokesman put its current coffee market share at 19.8 percent and Eduscho's at 10.4.
